notes: Overturn confirmed, the MESSAGE arm of the same cause. The receiving area is the group's maximum length (VI.5.8.4 GR3b), so a message shorter than it falls under GR8b: left-aligned, the rest of the area unchanged, one RECEIVE, END KEY 2. The compiler hands PendingReceive the current-length image, so the message is treated as larger than the area (GR8c): it is split, END KEY 0, and the remainder is held as a new message. Rerun g2.cob: RM 0004 0 GN=5; own r4own.cob: IN 0002 0 for a 4-character message into a 10-position area. Note PB5377 is right. kb/Work PB5377 holds the defect (adjudication: held-85/set5/decisions.json).
